arms.description: One all-shifts survey on two fixed fixtures; eighty memberships at every shift, no early stop.
Integrated roots-set oracle and independent original public-source arithmetic; no separate process or independent cost is invented.

authors: Shifted-cover execution-contract coordinator; model identity unverified

claims.text: All shifts are enumerated with complete base/source square and zero masks, and checked by separate roots-set membership and independent public-source arithmetic. No collector, rank or advantage conclusion follows.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Complete deterministic finite survey with a separately implemented exact membership oracle, no noisy comparative metric.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Every singular or ineligible shift is retained with its masks; oracle checks exclusions, not a hypothesized null population.

positive.not_applicable_reason: No shift is assumed eligible. Existing marked-small software tests check the shifted cover maps; actual square/zero mask positives are checked exhaustively by roots-set oracle.

decision_rule.statistic: Exact finite masks and counted frames.
decision_rule.text: Describe complete finite admissibility by fixture, with eligible and singular counts and public-source lift coverage. No collector experiment or scientific state transition.
decision_rule.threshold: Complete exact all-shifts masks and separate finite oracle equality.

extensions.checkpoint_semantics: Actual canonical S3 gate; no in-process restore; retries fresh output and invalid clocks.
extensions.counter_scope: Membership and source-point setup counters; no collection, rank or complete-S costs.
extensions.export_unit: Four method/fixture rows share two actual survey fixture cells and one physical process. Reference counts duplicate exact oracle comparisons and must not be summed; reference resources and counters are empty.

inadmissible: Survey before committed exact source, prospective frozen protocol, actual S3 checkpoint gate and explicit root release.
Selecting shifts by collector yield, changing bases/curves or public source order.
Claiming collector/rank/isogeny/scalar-action or attack advantage from cover admissibility.
Inventing an independent oracle process or duplicating shared resources.
invalidation_rules: Source/input change or oracle mismatch prevents verified complete observation.
No isolated timing, collection/rank or ECDLP performance conclusion.

literature.claim: Membership representation is separate from relation-solving and linear-algebra costs.
A shifted even-sextic frame maps to the same original E; its auxiliary E2 is not assumed isogenous or a scalar action. Exact old base/public sources remain fixed.

record: full rows, bit masks, coefficients and singularity reason
